title: Palindromic Substrings
statement: Count all contiguous palindromic substrings. Equal text at different positions counts separately.

examples.explanation: Three single letters and the whole string count.
Add the pair aa to the three single letters.

hints: Conceptual: A one-character span always counts.
Directional: Each successful expansion identifies one distinct pair of endpoints.
Implementation: Try centers at characters and between characters, counting every matching radius.
complexityAnalysis: O(n²) time and O(1) extra space.
